Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 5. Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Pre-Qualification criteria for Supply of Wet Shaking Table (Lab, model) at IRERC 1) PQ Criteria- Technical: 1.1) The Bidder shall be M/s. MD Mineral Technologies Pvt Ltd; who is the authorised distributor for Gravity Separation Tables by the OEM, M/s Holman-Wifley Ltd., UK. The Bidder should submit valid authorisation c ertificate from OEM in this regard. 1.2) The Bidder should have supplied at least 1 No. Wet Shaking Table/ Gravity Separation Table to any Central/State Govt. Institutions/Public Sector Undertakings or Reputed Private Organization during the last seven years ending on 31.10.2026. To verify the same, The Bidder/OEM shall submit the following: -

a. Copies of Purchase Order/s and b. Copies of Installation/Work completion certificate/ Performance reports issued for the evidencing the suc cessful supply against the same Purchase Order/s. Bid meeting PQ - 1 (1.1), (1.2) only will be considered for further processing subject to meeting technical a nd commercial conditions specified in the tender. Delivery Period: The supply shall be made within 240 calendar days from the date of receipt of Order. Schedule of payment: i) Payment of 90% of the base amount (exclusive of GST) and 100% of GST applicable shall be made after r eceipt, installation, testing, & acceptance of the Equipment along with tax Invoice duly certified by the Offi cer-in-Charge/Engineer-in-charge. ii) The remaining 10% shall be released after completion of Guarantee period of 12 months. Alternatively, 10% amount shall be paid on submission of Bank Guarantee for equivalent amount from any Nationalized/ Scheduled Bank valid throughout 12 months and 60 days beyond the date of completion of all contractual obligations. Note: All specifications, terms and conditions mentioned in the "Buyer Specification Document" are applica ble to this bid. .
